decisionsTitle: The shop's forms get «Copiază și tradu tot»
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-10:** «On this T-shirt product page we are missing the bilingual AI translate button».

**What was wrong.** §464 put DeepL behind a one-method adapter and §482 promised one always-visible «Copiază și tradu tot: RO → EN» on every editor, greyed with the setup steps until the key is set. The shop (§683, moved to `/admin/shop` by §687) shipped without it: neither the product form nor «Cum se plătește» carried the button, and the allowlist (`translate/domain/fields.ts`) knew `titleEn` only, for «Echipa»'s boxes.

**Decision.** `TranslateAllButton` sits at the top of the product form — the «Adaugă un produs» form and each product's edit form — and of the settings form, exactly where «Echipa» places it. It takes no props: the backoffice layout's `TranslateProvider` already carries the provider's availability and the setup link (§482), so `admin/shop/page.tsx` passes nothing new. The allowlist gains `descriptionEn` and `paymentEn`, each with its Romanian twin (`descriptionRo`, `paymentRo`), both plain multi-line texts (not rich text); `titleEn` was already on it. The server still refuses any other name (BR-REQ-060-01); the press saves nothing, and the ordinary save keeps asserting `canManageShop`.

**Who sees it.** A reader for whom `canTranslateTexts` holds (§464: the Redactor, the Organizer, the Administrator, the Superadministrator) — and the shop's forms render only for who may manage the shop. So the Administrator and the Superadministrator get the button. A volunteer holding the grant «Gestionează magazinul» (§687) does not: `canTranslateTexts` is `canEditTexts || canMessageParticipants`, which excludes a volunteer, and this change does not touch the predicate. The Organizer sees the shop read-only and gets no form, hence no button.

**Open question for the owner.** Should a volunteer holding «Gestionează magazinul» also be able to translate? It would need `canTranslateTexts` to count that grant (the translation allowance is the club's money: DeepL's free tier).

**Proof.** `tests/unit/translate/shop-button.test.ts` renders the shop card in Romanian and English (three buttons: payment, new product, one product's edit form; greyed without a key; none for a role that may not); `tests/unit/translate/domain.test.ts` covers the two new names and their twins.
changelogLine: - **«Copiază și tradu tot: RO → EN» on the shop's forms** — the product's title and description and «Cum se plătește» get the same one-press translate button as «Echipa»; a volunteer with the shop grant does not see it yet. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: The shop's product form (new and edit) and «Cum se plătește» carry «Copiază și tradu tot: RO → EN» in both languages, and `descriptionEn` and `paymentEn` are on the translation allowlist as plain texts with their Romanian twins (2026-10-10, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
